name: Fenix A320 family
measured: MSFS 2024, Fenix A319, 2026-10-05: cargo doors through the EFB's ground service items (doors.cargo.forward opened EXIT OPEN:8, exit 9, seen as the FWD cargo door; doors.cargo.aft, exit 10, by elimination: both moved together from the EFB); TOGGLE_AIRCRAFT_EXIT 9 and 10 do nothing; fenix.doors.cargo.*.movement only greys the EFB button out while moving. Exits 2, 6, 12, 13 read 100 % and never move (emergency or overwing exits?): left out. The passenger doors by exit, each seen opening: TOGGLE_AIRCRAFT_EXIT 1 = L1, 4 = L2, 5 = R1, 8 = R2 (k toggles EXIT OPEN:k-1). Exits 2, 3, 6, 7, 12 and 13 move EXIT OPEN but no passenger door: cargo or service hatches, not identified, left out; 9-11 and 14-30 do nothing. 2026-10-04 (#700): TOGGLE_AIRCRAFT_EXIT k toggles EXIT OPEN:k-1 for k = 1..8. 2026-10-04: ground controls (#667): the main door by the default TOGGLE_AIRCRAFT_EXIT (exit 1) and the parking brake by the default PARKING_BRAKES both work (open and closed, released and set, read back); chocks and GPU only through the EFB API; with the chocks off the Fenix reads its parking brake released (BRAKE PARKING INDICATOR 0), set again with them on. Measured cold and dark; perhaps because the aircraft is off (no brake pressure, the chocks holding it), to recheck powered. 2026-10-03: each switch toggled while both the standard SimVars and the L:vars were traced. COM_STBY_RADIO_SET_HZ sets the RMP 1 standby (read back from L:N_PED_RMP1_STDBY: COM STANDBY FREQUENCY:1 stays as it was), and S_PED_RMP1_XFER puts it on active, which COM ACTIVE FREQUENCY:1 follows (2026-10-03, powered). The standard battery, avionics and external power do not follow the Fenix (battery and avionics read on while dark, the main bus reads battery 2's 28 V, external power 'not feeding' with EXT PWR ON); lights, parking brake, EXIT OPEN:0 and the transponder do and stay standard. L:var list from FSUIPC7's WASM 'List Lvars'.
